label: L23UGSR-5HaxD2HaxD
description: MikroTik L23UGSR-5HaxD2HaxD (L23UGSR-5HaxD2HaxD) — 1x 1G RJ45, 1x SFP, Wi-Fi 2.4 GHz + 5 GHz. ARM 32bit 2-core IPQ-5010.
notes: Power method from the mikrotik.com spec table: **PoE in: Passive PoE** (18-28 V) on `eth1`. Input is recorded on the first Ethernet port because the table states the method and voltage but does not name the port, and every MikroTik with a PoE-IN DC input takes it there. Max power consumption 25 W.
